title: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Diffusion Snap-Back Reconstruction: A Forensic Approach
usefulness_reason: Focuses on an interpretable forensic approach using reconstruction dynamics and simple logistic regression, making it relevant to explainable detectors.
key_findings: By tracking how perceptual similarity measures (LPIPS, SSIM, and PSNR) change across different reconstruction strengths (diffusion snap-back), the method captures compact and interpretable signals.
Achieves an AUROC of 0.993 under stratified five-fold cross-validation and 0.990 on a holdout split using only logistic regression on a balanced dataset of 4,000 images.
research_problem: Detecting AI-generated images using an interpretable forensic approach based on diffusion snap-back reconstruction behavior rather than hidden pixel-level traces.
